name: Software Engineer Cover Letter
opening: I am excited to apply for the Software Engineering Internship position at Meta. As a passionate B.Tech Information Technology student with a strong foundation in modern web technologies and software engineering principles, I am confident that my skills align with your team's goals.
body: During my studies at National Engineering College, I have developed expertise in React, Node.js, JavaScript, and database management. I have successfully built multiple web applications including an AI Resume Builder and intelligent data processing systems.
My strength lies in analytical problem-solving, collaborative teamwork, and quickly adapting to modern engineering frameworks.
closing: Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how my background fits Meta's innovative projects.
